Where Winds Meet Hexi Expansion Gameplay Preview - SHOULD You PLAY It? Is it WORTH It?
In this video, we'll be taking a look at the upcoming update for the Epic Wuxia Open World Action Adventure RPG set in ancient China, Where Winds Meet. And On March 6, available on PC, PS5 and mobile. Where Winds Meet released its first major Expansion and content update to the game since launch, adding a brand new region called Hexi.

Get the Game HERE: https://bit.ly/4sbXBTl
Sponsored by: Where Wnds Meet

First Major HEXI Expansion
The biggest content drop since launch! 100+ hours of new content to explore, 3 vast new maps from scorching deserts to lush grasslands and icy peaks. Packed with 20+ sub‑regions and 11+ unique bosses. Dive into fresh storylines, tons of new gameplay, and special giveaways designed for the community. 

Where Winds Meet has consistently adhered to "Free + NO P2W" since launch, providing players with the best gaming experience.
